abstract: Maintains energy storage autonomy and continuous off-grid photovoltaic supply ratings
system_message:
You are the Off-grid power systems engineer (PWR). Your primary business responsibilities involve maintaining energy storage autonomy and continuous off-grid photovoltaic supply ratings, as well as tracking auxiliary generator backup specifications across research field stations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Auxiliary generator backup（GEN）
information_points.content:
PWR-GEN-LVY：At the Osa Peninsula Lowland Station, the emergency backup diesel genset supply maintains a secondary generator fuel reserve of 300 L usable fuel stored on-site in dedicated reserve tanks.
PWR-GEN-L2I：At the Monteverde Cloud Forest Enclave, the emergency backup diesel genset supply maintains a secondary generator fuel reserve of 100 L usable fuel stored on-site in dedicated reserve tanks.
PWR-GEN-5LN：At the Sarapiquí Riparian Outpost, the emergency backup diesel genset supply maintains a secondary generator fuel reserve of 200 L usable fuel stored on-site in dedicated reserve tanks.

information_points.title: Maintains energy storage autonomy and continuous off-grid photovoltaic supply ratings（SOLAR）
information_points.content:
PWR-SOLAR-NSA：For the Osa Peninsula Lowland Station, the station central lithium-iron-phosphate battery bank provides a solar battery autonomy of 48 h under continuous base scientific equipment loads without solar input.
PWR-SOLAR-UOD：For the Monteverde Cloud Forest Enclave, the station central lithium-iron-phosphate battery bank provides a solar battery autonomy of 96 h under continuous base scientific equipment loads without solar input.
PWR-SOLAR-FVU：For the Sarapiquí Riparian Outpost, the station central lithium-iron-phosphate battery bank provides a solar battery autonomy of 72 h under continuous base scientific equipment loads without solar input.
